This delay of 1548 days was caused by law &order and ROW issues and thus was beyond the control of the Petitioner. As regards contention of the Respondent BSPHCL that the reasons cited by the Petitioner are controllable and that the time over run should not be condoned, we note that the law & order issues and ROW issues have directly affected the execution of the assets and despite regular efforts made by the Petitioner at different levels, the issues could not be resolved. In our view, these issues were not within control of the Petitioner.
